issue.input_source: ECMWF operational IFS Open Data 0.25-degree step-0 and 0-6 hour fields for 2026-10-12 and 2026-10-13; experimental IFS-initialized subseasonal model
issue.scientific_status: Experimental IFS initialization; skin temperature is the ocean SST proxy and no matched IFS-initialized hindcast calibration is available.

initial_condition_source.label: IFS operational initialization
initial_condition_source.description: Operational ECMWF IFS fields aggregated into the model's two daily input states. Ocean skin temperature is used as the disclosed SST proxy. Experimental.

climatology_alignment.operation_order: interpolate each yearly native-ensemble mean, aggregate seven lead days, then equally average 20 years

observation_verification.message: Verification is withheld until every required observation day in a valid week is available.

wind850_climatology_alignment.operation_order: interpolate each yearly 51-member vector mean, aggregate seven lead days, then equally average 20 years

definitions.wind850_mean: shading: speed computed from the weekly ensemble-mean U/V components; arrows: the same weekly ensemble-mean U/V components
definitions.wind850_anomaly: shading: ensemble-mean vector speed minus the equally weighted mean of 20 yearly vector speeds; arrows: forecast U/V mean minus the 2002-2021 U/V model climatology

wind850_provenance.definition: shading: ensemble-mean vector speed minus the equally weighted mean of 20 yearly vector speeds; arrows: forecast U/V mean minus the 2002-2021 U/V model climatology

grid.value_order: latitude-major row order; latitude is north-to-south

rainfall_anomaly.label: Rainfall anomaly
rainfall_anomaly.description: Weekly-mean forecast minus lead-matched model climatology

temperature_anomaly.label: Temperature anomaly
temperature_anomaly.description: Weekly-mean forecast minus lead-matched model climatology

wind850_mean.label: Weekly mean 850 hPa wind
wind850_mean.description: Shading is the speed of the weekly ensemble-mean wind vector; arrows are the weekly ensemble-mean U/V components

wind850_anomaly.label: 850 hPa wind anomaly
wind850_anomaly.description: Shading is the weekly-mean wind-speed anomaly; arrows are the weekly U/V vector-component anomaly

rainfall_efi.label: Rainfall Extreme Forecast Index
rainfall_efi.description: Tail-weighted difference between the raw forecast-member and matched model-climate CDFs
rainfall_efi.baseline: FuXi native reforecasts, 2002–2021 · three initialization dates

temperature_efi.label: Temperature Extreme Forecast Index
temperature_efi.description: Tail-weighted difference between the raw forecast-member and matched model-climate CDFs
temperature_efi.baseline: FuXi native reforecasts, 2002–2021 · three initialization dates

rainfall_sot_upper.label: Rainfall upper-tail Shift of Tails
rainfall_sot_upper.description: Forecast-tail displacement relative to the matched model-climate 90–99% or 10–1% tail width
rainfall_sot_upper.baseline: FuXi native reforecasts, 2002–2021 · three initialization dates

temperature_sot_upper.label: Temperature upper-tail Shift of Tails
temperature_sot_upper.description: Forecast-tail displacement relative to the matched model-climate 90–99% or 10–1% tail width
temperature_sot_upper.baseline: FuXi native reforecasts, 2002–2021 · three initialization dates

temperature_sot_lower.label: Temperature lower-tail Shift of Tails
temperature_sot_lower.description: Forecast-tail displacement relative to the matched model-climate 90–99% or 10–1% tail width
temperature_sot_lower.baseline: FuXi native reforecasts, 2002–2021 · three initialization dates

rainfall_spread.label: Rainfall ensemble spread
rainfall_spread.description: Population standard deviation across weekly-total forecast members

temperature_spread.label: Temperature ensemble spread
temperature_spread.description: Population standard deviation across weekly-mean forecast members

extreme_definition.february_alignment: Native last-day-of-February starts share slot 0228; leap-year source dates are 0229.
extreme_definition.efi: ECMWF tail-weighted CDF index; bounded to -1…+1 after numerical integration
extreme_definition.sot_upper: (forecast q90 - climate q99) / (climate q99 - climate q90)
extreme_definition.sot_lower: (forecast q10 - climate q01) / (climate q01 - climate q10); temperature only
extreme_definition.warning: EFI and SOT are raw model-relative ensemble indices, not probabilities, warnings, calibration, skill, guaranteed impacts, or evidence of forecast accuracy.
